response.original_title: I Believe in Bigfoot: Mating Season
response.overview: The local police department have arrested a young man in connection with the murder of two young women in the forest. Elliott told the story of the legendary creature BigFoot and how he fought and killed BigFoot. The FBI is brought in to assist with the case. FBI agent Big Wang thinks Elliott is having a mental breakdown from seeing his friends being killed by a bear in the forest. A large group of police and FBI Agents enter the forest looking to hunt a bear but in the end it's more than a bear and BigFoot is hunting them down one by one.
response.title: I Believe in Bigfoot: Mating Season
